Disclosure  to  Promote  the  Right  To  Information 

Whereas  the  Parliament  of  India  has  set  out  to  provide  a  practical  regime  of  right  to 
information  for  citizens  to  secure  access  to  information  under  the  control  of  public  authorities, 
in  order  to  promote  transparency  and  accountability  in  the  working  of  every  public  authority, 
and  whereas  the  attached  publication  of  the  Bureau  of  Indian  Standards  is  of  particular  interest 
to  the  public,  particularly  disadvantaged  communities  and  those  engaged  in  the  pursuit  of 
education  and  knowledge,  the  attached  public  safety  standard  is  made  available  to  promote  the 
timely  dissemination  of  this  information  in  an  accurate  manner  to  the  public. 


Mazdoor  Kisan  Shakti  Sangathan 
"The  Right  to  Information,  The  Right  to  Live"

*4  FABRICATION 

4.1  The  stirrup  plate  shall  consist  of  a  plate  and  a  channel  which  could 
be  integral  or  in  two  pieces.  In  case  of  two  piece  construction,  the 
plate  and  the  channel  shall  be  welded  or  brazed  along  the  entire 
length.  In  case  of  integral  construction,  the  channel  shall  be  covered 
by  a  simple  strip  welded  throughout  its  length.  The  strength  of 
welded/brazed  joint  shall  be  not  less  than  50  kg/mm2/

SPECIFICATION  FOR 
MODULAR  LOWER  LIMB  ORTHOTIC  COMPONENTS 

PART  III    STIRRUP  PLATES 


1.  Scope  —  Dimensional  and  other  requirements  of  stirrup  plates  for  modular  lower  limb  braces. 

2.  Shape  and  Dimensions  — The  stirrup  plates  shall  be  in  three  sizes  to  suit  the  three  sizes  of 
split  stirrup.    The  stirrup  plate  for  right  and  left  foot  shall  be  as  shown  in  Fig.  1.

STIRRUP  PLATE 

3.  Material 

3.1  Plate  —  Mild  steel  sheet/strip  cold  rolled  annealed  Grade  0  of  IS  :  513-1973  'Specification  for 
cold  rolled  carbon  steel  sheets  (second revision)'  or  hot  rolled  annealed  Grade  0  of  IS  :  1079-1973 
'Specification  for  hot  rolled  carbon  steel  sheet  and  strip  (third  revision)',  thickness  2'0  mm 
minimum.  «* 

3.2  Channel—  Mild  steel  sheet/strip  cold  rolled  Grade  0  of  IS  :  513-1973  or  hot-rolled  annealed 
Grade  0  of  IS  :  1079-1973,  thickness  1*6  mm  minimum.
